---
name: "nf-core/vcf_annotate_vepyr"
description: "Optionally download a vepyr cache from Hugging Face and normalise a\
  \ VCF with\nbcftools norm, then annotate it with Ensembl VEP consequences using\
  \ vepyr and\nreturn the bgzip VCF with its tabix index.\n\nGive the cache either\
  \ as `ch_cache` or as a Hugging Face dataset in\n`val_hf_repo`, such as `biodatageeks/vepyr_116_GRCh38_ensembl`;\
  \ setting both,\nor neither, is an error. The repository is downloaded once and\
  \ shared across\nall samples. To pin the cache or download only some contigs, add\
  \ `--revision`\nand `--include` to `HUGGINGFACE_DOWNLOAD`'s `ext.args`. A partial\
  \ download\nmust include every entity's manifest and all contigs present in the\
  \ VCF:\n\n```\nwithName: 'HUGGINGFACE_DOWNLOAD' {\n    ext.args = \"--revision <commit>\
  \ --include '*/chr22.parquet' --include '*/chrom_manifest.json'\"\n}\n```\n\nWhat\
  \ bcftools norm does comes from `BCFTOOLS_NORM`'s `ext.args`. Keep its\noutput bgzip\
  \ VCF (`--output-type z`): `VEPYR_ANNOTATE` runs a single pipeline\nfor BCF (`-Ob`,\
  \ `-Ou`) and plain VCF (`-Ov`). vepyr's Ensembl VEP parity tests\nuse this configuration,\
  \ which splits multiallelic records without\nleft-aligning indels. `--write-index=tbi`\
  \ is optional and saves the tabix step\nin `VEPYR_ANNOTATE`:\n\n```\nwithName: 'BCFTOOLS_NORM'\
  \ {\n    ext.args = '--multiallelics -both --do-not-normalize --output-type z --write-index=tbi'\n\
  }\n```\n"
keywords:
- "vcf"
- "annotation"
- "normalisation"
- "vep"
- "vepyr"
- "bcftools"
- "huggingface"
components:
- "bcftools/norm"
- "huggingface/download"
- "vepyr/annotate"
input:
- ch_vcf:
    description: "VCF to normalise and annotate, with its optional tabix/CSI index\
      \ (pass [] for none)\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(vcf), path(tbi) ]\n"
- ch_cache:
    description: "vepyr Parquet cache directory produced by vepyr's cache build. Must\
      \ be\na value channel (e.g. `channel.value(...)` or `.collect()`): a queue\n\
      channel annotates only the first sample. Pass [[], []] when\nval_hf_repo is\
      \ set.\nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(cache) ]\n"
- ch_fasta:
    description: "Reference FASTA, its samtools faidx index and, for a bgzip FASTA,\
      \ its\n.gzi index (pass [] for an uncompressed FASTA). Required: vepyr always\n\
      annotates with `--everything`, which needs it, and bcftools norm reads\nit when\
      \ `val_normalize` is true. Must be a value channel: a queue\nchannel annotates\
      \ only the first sample.\nStructure: [ val(meta3), path(fasta), path(fai), path(gzi)\
      \ ]\n"
- val_cache_version:
    type: "integer"
    description: "Ensembl cache version to assert against the cache metadata, or []\
      \ to skip the check"
- ch_plugin_cache:
    description: "Root of a vepyr plugin cache tree holding plugin/<name>/ directories\
      \ (optional, pass [ [], [] ])\nStructure: [ val(meta4), path(plugin_cache) ]\n"
- val_normalize:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Run BCFTOOLS_NORM before annotation. Pipelines should default this\
      \ to true."
- val_hf_repo:
    type: "string"
    description: "Hugging Face dataset holding the vepyr Parquet cache, e.g.\n`biodatageeks/vepyr_116_GRCh38_ensembl`\
      \ (a `datasets/` prefix is\noptional). Downloaded once and shared across samples.\
      \ Pass '' or [] to\nuse ch_cache instead.\n"
output:
- vcf_tbi:
    description: "Annotated bgzip VCF and its tabix index\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(vcf), path(tbi) ]\n"
authors:
- "@mwiewior"
maintainers:
- "@mwiewior"
version: "0.0.0-f3a7fb3"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/bcftools/norm@0.0.0-c87ca93"
  - "nf-core/huggingface/download@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/vepyr/annotate@0.0.0-f3a7fb3"
